sentences.text: Tezaab -LRB- translation : Acid -RRB- , released on 11 November 1988 , is an Indian action romantic Hindi movie starring Anil Kapoor and Madhuri Dixit in lead roles .	Anil Kapoor	Anil Kapoor	Madhuri Dixit	Madhuri Dixit	Hindi	Hindi	action	Action film	romantic	romance film	Hindi movie	Bollywood
The film gave actress Madhuri Dixit her first big break , making her an overnight star .	Madhuri Dixit	Madhuri Dixit
It reaffirmed Anil Kapoor 's star status , after a successful Mr India -LRB- 1987 -RRB- .	Anil Kapoor	Anil Kapoor	Mr India	Mr India
The film was produced and directed by N. Chandra .	N. Chandra	N. Chandra
The music is by Laxmikant-Pyarelal .	Laxmikant-Pyarelal	Laxmikant-Pyarelal
Tezaab is known for the song `` Ek Do Teen , '' , `` kehdo ke tum ho meri '' .
It ran in theatres for more than 50 weeks becoming a golden jubilee , and it was the highest blockbuster at the box office for the year 1988 in Bollywood .	Bollywood	Bollywood
With Tezaab , N Chandra scored a box office hat-trick with his previous hits Ankush -LRB- 1986 -RRB- and Pratighaat -LRB- 1987 -RRB- .	Ankush	Ankush	Pratighaat	Pratighaat
Tezaab was critically acclaimed and garnered four Filmfare Awards from twelve nominations .	Filmfare Awards	Filmfare Awards
